_doc: HTML + Vue closed world: index.html is a served page (entry_re); <script src>, <link href>, <a href> are file edges (URLs, fragments and queries dropped); the module script imports ./mod.js; the classic inline script defines the global onGo that onclick calls (soft script root); src/main.js imports App.vue, whose script block is JS/TS and whose template words (handler, fmt, <MyComp/>) are uses; Stale.vue and the functions nobody names are dead. Unquoted attribute values are HTML too: <script src=js/late.js> and <form action=submit.php> are file edges, @click=onBare in a Vue template is a use of onBare. A link href="javascript:jj()" (quoted or bare) calls jj from a classic script (rules scan_value).
